companyId.label: Company ID
companyId.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

query.query: SELECT Id, DisplayName FROM Customer STARTPOSITION 1 MAXRESULTS 1000
SELECT Id, Name, AccountType FROM Account STARTPOSITION 1 MAXRESULTS 1000
SELECT Id, DisplayName FROM Vendor STARTPOSITION 1 MAXRESULTS 1000
SELECT Id, Name FROM Term MAXRESULTS 1000

find_invoice.label: Find Invoice
find_invoice.description: Search for an invoice by its number in QuickBooks.

invoice_number.label: Invoice Number
invoice_number.description: The document number (DocNumber) of the invoice to search for.

find_invoice.afterResponse:
const found = (response.QueryResponse || {})['Invoice'];
return found && found.length > 0 ? {found: true, result: found[0]} : {found: false, result: {}};

find_customer.label: Find Customer
find_customer.description: Search for a customer by display name in QuickBooks.

search_term.label: Customer Name
search_term.description: The display name of the customer to search for.

find_customer.afterResponse:
const found = (response.QueryResponse || {})['Customer'];
return found && found.length > 0 ? {found: true, result: found[0]} : {found: false, result: {}};

find_payment.label: Find Payment
find_payment.description: Finds an existing payment in QuickBooks.

customerId.label: Customer ID
customerId.description: The ID of the customer to find payments for.

find_payment.afterResponse:
const found = (response.QueryResponse || {}).Payment;
return found && found.length > 0 ? {found: true, result: found} : {found: false, result: []};

create_invoice.label: Create Invoice

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.description: Line items for the invoice, as a JSON list of {description, amount, detailType (SalesItemLineDetail), itemId, quantity, unitPrice}.

emailStatus.label: Email Status
emailStatus.description: Specify whether the invoice should be emailed after creation.

billEmail.label: Billing Email Address
billEmail.description: Email address to send the invoice to. Required if Email Status is "Needs To Be Sent". Overrides customer default.

dueDate.label: Due Date
dueDate.description: The date when the payment for the invoice is due. If not provided, default term from customer or company is used.

docNumber.label: Invoice Number
docNumber.description: Optional reference number for the invoice. If not provided, QuickBooks assigns the next sequential number.

txnDate.label: Transaction Date
txnDate.description: The date entered on the transaction. Defaults to the current date if not specified.

privateNote.label: Private Note (Memo)
privateNote.description: Note to self. Does not appear on the invoice sent to the customer.

customerMemo.label: Customer Memo (Statement Memo)
customerMemo.description: Memo to be displayed on the invoice sent to the customer (appears on statement).

create_invoice.afterResponse:
if (response.Fault) throw new Error('QuickBooks API Error: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Message).join(', ') + ' - ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Detail).join(', '));
return response.Invoice;

create_expense.label: Create Expense
create_expense.description: Creates an expense transaction (purchase) in QuickBooks.

accountRef.label: Bank/Credit Card Account
accountRef.description: The account from which the expense was paid.

entityRef.label: Payee (Vendor)
entityRef.description: Optional - The vendor the expense was paid to.

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.description: Details of the expense (e.g., categories or items purchased). At least one line is required. A JSON list of {amount, description, detailType (AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail), expenseAccountId}.

create_expense.afterResponse:
if (response.Fault) throw new Error('QuickBooks API Error creating expense: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Message).join(', ') + ' - Detail: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Detail).join(', '));
return response.Purchase;

create_bill.label: Create Bill
create_bill.description: Creates a bill (accounts payable) in QuickBooks.

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.description: Details of the bill (expense categories). At least one line is required. A JSON list of {amount, description, detailType (AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail), expenseAccountId, classId}; classId only counts on QuickBooks Plus and Advanced plans with class tracking per line.

txnDate.label: Bill Date
txnDate.description: The date of the bill. Defaults to today if empty.

dueDate.label: Due Date
dueDate.description: The date the payment is due. If empty, the vendor/company term is used.

create_bill.afterResponse:
if (response.Fault) throw new Error('QuickBooks API Error creating bill: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Message).join(', ') + ' - Detail: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Detail).join(', '));
return response.Bill;

create_vendor.label: Create Vendor

displayName.label: Vendor Display Name
displayName.description: The name QuickBooks will show for this vendor. Must be unique across all vendors, customers, and employees.

billAddrState.label: Billing Address State
billAddrState.description: State or province code, e.g. CA.

vendor1099.label: Track for 1099
vendor1099.description: Whether this vendor should be tracked for 1099 reporting.

acctNum.label: Account Number
acctNum.description: Your own reference/account number for this vendor (external ID). Shown on checks.

termRef.label: Payment Term
termRef.description: Optional. The default payment term for bills from this vendor.

create_vendor.afterResponse:
if (response.Fault) throw new Error('QuickBooks API Error creating vendor: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Message).join(', ') + ' - Detail: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Detail).join(', '));
return response.Vendor;

find_vendor.label: Find Vendor
find_vendor.description: Search for a vendor in QuickBooks by display name or account number.

search_term.label: Search Value
search_term.description: The exact vendor display name or account number to search for, depending on Search By.

find_vendor.afterResponse:
const vendor = ((response.QueryResponse || {}).Vendor || [])[0];
return vendor ? {found: true, result: vendor} : {found: false, result: {}};

find_account.label: Find Account
find_account.description: List or search the chart of accounts to get an account Id (e.g. an expense account for a bill).

search_term.label: Account Name Contains
search_term.description: Optional. Filter accounts whose name contains this text.

find_account.afterResponse:
const accounts = (response.QueryResponse || {}).Account || [];
return {found: accounts.length > 0, result: accounts};

record_payment.label: Record Payment
record_payment.description: Records a customer payment in QuickBooks, optionally applying it to invoices.

totalAmount.label: Total Amount
totalAmount.description: The total amount of the payment received.

lineItems.label: Apply to Invoices
lineItems.description: Optional. Apply this payment to specific invoices, as a JSON list of {invoiceId, amount}. Leave empty to keep the amount unapplied.

depositToAccountId.label: Deposit To Account ID
depositToAccountId.description: Optional. The account to deposit the payment into. Defaults to Undeposited Funds if empty.

txnDate.label: Payment Date
txnDate.description: The date the payment was received. Defaults to today if empty.

paymentRefNum.label: Reference Number
paymentRefNum.description: Optional reference number for the payment (e.g. check number).

record_payment.afterResponse:
if (response.Fault) throw new Error('QuickBooks API Error recording payment: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Message).join(', ') + ' - Detail: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Detail).join(', '));
return response.Payment;

record_bill_payment.label: Record Bill Payment (AP)
record_bill_payment.description: Pays one or more vendor bills in QuickBooks, in full or in part, by check or credit card.

payFromAccountRef.label: Pay From Account ID
payFromAccountRef.description: The ID of the checking/savings account (for Check) or credit card account (for Credit Card) the payment is made from.

billLines.label: Bills To Pay
billLines.description: One or more bills this payment applies to, as a JSON list of {billId, amount}. Amounts can be less than the bill balance for a partial payment.

record_bill_payment.afterResponse:
if (response.Fault) throw new Error('QuickBooks API Error recording bill payment: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Message).join(', ') + ' - Detail: ' + response.Fault.Error.map((e) => e.Detail).join(', '));
return response.BillPayment;

read_aging_report.label: Read AR/AP Aging
read_aging_report.description: Reads an accounts receivable or accounts payable aging report from QuickBooks.

reportDate.label: As Of Date
reportDate.description: The date to age balances against. Defaults to today if empty.

agingPeriod.label: Days Per Period
agingPeriod.description: Number of days in each aging bucket (e.g. 30).

numPeriods.label: Number of Periods
numPeriods.description: How many aging buckets to include.

agingMethod.label: Aging Method
agingMethod.description: Whether buckets are calculated from the report date or from each transaction's due date.

pastDue.label: Minimum Days Past Due
pastDue.description: Only include transactions overdue by at least this many days.

new_invoice.label: New Invoice
new_invoice.description: Triggers when an invoice is created .

new_expense.label: New Expense (Purchase)
new_expense.description: Triggers when an Expense (Purchase) is created.

new_customer.label: New Customer
new_customer.description: Triggers when a new customer is created.

new_deposit.label: New Deposit
new_deposit.description: Triggers when a Deposit is created.

new_transfer.label: New Transfer
new_transfer.description: Triggers when a Transfer is created.

new_or_updated_invoice.label: New or Updated Invoice
new_or_updated_invoice.description: Triggers when an invoice is created or updated in QuickBooks.

payment_received.label: Payment Received
payment_received.description: Triggers when a new customer payment is recorded in QuickBooks.

new_bill.label: New Bill
new_bill.description: Triggers when a new bill (accounts payable) is created in QuickBooks.
